svg.title: Three deployment tiers behind one routing gate
svg.desc: A routing gate comes first: foundry-covered and design-sensitive content stays in tier 1, generic tasks can go to tiers 2 and 3. Tier 1, inside your building: full on-prem with open weights, a modest 30B-class local model on your hardware, $42,000 up front for up to 25 engineers (estimate). Tier 2, inside your cloud account: a frontier model in your tenancy, such as Claude through AWS Bedrock or GCP Vertex, or OpenAI's models through Azure. Tier 3, at a vendor with zero data retention: generic tasks only. Tiers 2 and 3 need no capital and cost $28 to $230 per engineer a year at measured usage (estimate). Every tier ships with local retrieval over your documentation, and your legal team decides which tiers your foundry NDA allows.
